      public void initCardPlayers() throws IllegalArgumentException
      Description copied from class: EventCard
      This method is immediately invoked when the card a new card is extracted. Can be overridden to specify different initialization modes (like reverse player order) We do not use the board players list since in some cards the players order could be different

    • setDiceThrowResult

      void setDiceThrowResult(int diceThrowResult)
      Forces the dice throw to ignore the internal RNG.
      NOTE: This method is used only when testing the card.
      NOTE: This method must be invoked before an useCard() method when the dice throw result needs to be manipulated.
      Parameters:
      diceThrowResult - The artificial dice throw result to set the card to.
